newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Suzano still in CVRD bid - CSN.
newsitem.headline: Suzano still in CVRD bid - CSN.

text.p: Brazilian pulp and papermaker Cia Suzano de Papel e Celulose is still pre-qualified as a member of the Valepar consortium bidding for Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD), the consortium leader said.

CSN chairman Benjamin Steinbruch told reporters Suzano had not informed the consortium it would pull out of the bid for 45 percent of CVRD's voting shares, due to have been auctioned off Tuesday but delayed by court injunctions.
"Suzano continues to be pre-qualified and has not indicated it will not take part," Steinbruch said.
The Gazeta Mercantil financial daily reported Wednesday that Suzano had decided to pull out of the Valepar consortium just 24 hours after aluminium company Aluminum Co of America also left.

Steinbruch said he hoped the auction would still begin Wednesday but acknowledged everything depended on the courts, especially a high court in Brasilia due to rule on a government bid to quash a host of injunctions.
